posts.text:
I feel like a relic of a different era in American politics.

People can accuse me of making this personal, but it is personal. My father, Lindsey Graham and Joe Lieberman were the three most significant men in my life. Lindsey and Joe weren’t just political figures to me. They were family. They were my uncles.

You can hear our full tribute to Senator Graham on today's episode of Citizen McCain 🧡piped.video/1nJfQ9Eff5w
posts.summary: Expresses emotional connection to late Senator Graham as family figure

posts.text:
I am feeling quite raw and emotional this morning - thank you to everyone who has reached out to ask me on their programs to talk about Lindsey.  I am frankly not up for it - I will just be doing my own show Citizen McCain (and @KTAR923 in Arizona as I do every Monday) today. 

I am deeply grateful to @TGowdySC & @KevinPWalling for agreeing to join me on my show to talk about the man I called Uncle since childhood.

This is so distasteful and sick. Lindsey's body isn't even cold yet. You people are so vile.

Also, my dad knew nothing about golf, never once heard him speak of it ever other than he found it boring - I don't believe this quote at all. STOP.
Community note: The quote in question is from a verified 2021 article with the New York times. nytimes.com/2021/08/14/us/…
